task: Refactor n2b to Turborepo-like modular architecture

goals.name: Update root Cargo.toml, turbo.json, and package.json
goals.details: Adopt resolver 3, edition 2024, synthetic tasks (//#quality, //#lint), and replace biome with oxlint/oxfmt.

goals.name: Split n2b-core into micro-crates
goals.details: Extract n2b-types, n2b-rules, n2b-scanners, n2b-report, n2b-ai, n2b-github into crates/.

goals.name: Refactor Rust imports
goals.details: Replace all internal crate:: schema references to explicitly call the new micro-crates (e.g. n2b_types::...)

goals.name: Split TypeScript packages
goals.details: Break down @n2b/core into @n2b/cli, @n2b/types, @n2b/plugin, and @n2b/shims to mirror the Turborepo package architecture.

goals.name: Validate build & pipeline
goals.details: Run turbo run //#quality and cargo check --workspace to validate.
